text: Over the last 30 days, visitor reviews have highlighted issues with the food quality at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Two reviews specifically mentioned salads and entrees lacking flavor or having awkward combinations. One review noted the menu includes healthy options but suggested the recipes need adjustment. There were no positive comments about the food, and the overall average rating was low. Addressing these concerns could improve visitor satisfaction.

windows.90: Visitor feedback over the last 90 days indicates ongoing concerns with the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several reviews mention bland or poorly executed dishes, limited menu options, and dissatisfaction with portion sizes and pricing. Some visitors also noted issues with service, including the lack of water cups. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the food quality and menu variety appear to need improvement to better meet visitor expectations.
